About Blue Ridge Solutions, Inc

We are Blue Ridge, creators of the leading supply chain platform for distributors, retailers, and manufacturers. Our fast-growing and exciting SaaS supply chain planning platform provides cutting-edge supply chain solutions including forecasting and demand planning, replenishment, S&OP, rough-cut capacity planning, and pricing. Our software helps businesses gain control, improve forecasting precision, reduce costs, improve service levels, and increase profit.


We are looking for a passionate individual who is excited about the intersection of AI technology and supply chain optimization. The Lead Full-stack Engineer - GenAI is responsible for building and deploying advanced machine learning systems with a focus on generative AI technologies that drive value for our supply chain solutions. You will lead the design and development of production-grade Generative AI (GenAI) and SaaS platforms. You’ll be the technical force behind scalable, secure, and intelligent systems that transform rapid PoCs into enterprise-ready solutions.


This is a strategic technical role within our AI/ML team, working at the intersection of cutting-edge research and practical implementation. You will be responsible for designing, developing, prototyping, improving and scaling ML systems from conception through production deployment, with emphasis on generative AI models and full-stack integration capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

GenAI/ML System Development

Design and develop Generative AI solutions using cloud-based managed AI services (e.g. Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker).
Design and develop AI Agent workflows using cloud and open source agentic frameworks.
Containerize AI applications and deploy them using cloud orchestration services.
Collaborate with data architects/engineers to build end-to-end AI pipelines.
Implement MLOps practices to automate the development, deployment, and monitoring of AI applications and models.
Implement and manage robust monitoring systems for AI solutions in production environments, ensuring continuous performance tracking, anomaly detection, and model drift analysis; collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy model updates, maintain version control, and optimize model efficiency over time.
Use Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to manage and version cloud resources for AI projects.
Ensure clear and accessible knowledge transfer to internal teams and create knowledge-sharing resources to ensure smooth transitions during model handoffs and system updates.
Contribute to the development of best practices and standards for AI engineering within the organization.


Technical Leadership & Innovation

Lead the architecture and implementation of ML systems that can process supply chain data at scale
Research and implement cutting-edge ML techniques including transformer models, reinforcement learning, and generative adversarial networks
Optimize model performance for production environments, ensuring low latency and high availability
Establish best practices for model versioning, monitoring, and continuous integration/deployment


Supply Chain Domain Excellence

Understand critical supply chain planning workflows and identify opportunities for AI-driven automation
Develop ML models that provide insights into potential supply disruptions and recommend automated resolutions
Build tools that increase the reach of supply chain solutions through partner integrations
Act as the voice of AI innovation within the supply chain domain


Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

University degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or related technical field, OR 5-7 years of equivalent experience in machine learning engineering
3+ years of hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying ML models and systems in production environments
3+ years of experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras) and generative AI models
Strong full-stack development experience with modern web technologies, ability to take concept to prototype

Technical Skills

Programming Languages: Expert-level proficiency in Python; proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL
ML/AI Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain, scikit-learn or equivalent
Generative AI: Experience with large language models (GPT, BERT, LLaMA), fine-tuning techniques (RLHF, LoRA), and prompt engineering or equivalent
Full-Stack Development: React, Node.js, REST APIs, microservices architecture
MLOps: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, model monitoring, and deployment automation or equivalent
Data Technologies: Apache Spark, streaming data processing, vector databases, data warehousing or equivalent

Core Competencies

Strong foundation in statistics, linear algebra, and optimization techniques
Experience with distributed systems and large-scale data processing
Proficiency in data structures, algorithms, and software engineering principles
Experience with A/B testing, model evaluation, and performance monitoring
Understanding of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies


Preferred Qualifications

Industry Experience

Supply Chain Software: Previous experience with supply chain management software, ERP systems, or logistics platforms is highly valued
Experience in B2B SaaS environments with enterprise-scale deployments
Background in operations research, industrial engineering, or supply chain optimization

Advanced Technical Skills

Experience with reinforcement learning for sequential decision-making problems
Knowledge of graph neural networks and their applications to supply chain networks
Familiarity with edge computing and model optimization for deployment constraints
Experience with modern vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB) for RAG applications


What We Offer

Free Medical/Dental/Vision (for Individual)

401(k) match

Unlimited PTO

Work-from-Home

Collaborative, fun environment


Blue Ridge is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Summary of position

The Senior Data Scientist will play a critical role in developing, implementing, and maintaining predictive models and analytical frameworks that directly influence consumer lending acquisition, underwriting, fraud prevention, and portfolio performance.

This position is hands-on, requiring strong technical expertise in data science and machine learning, paired with the ability to collaborate across business functions. The Senior Data Scientist will apply advanced statistical and machine learning techniques to optimize lending policies, improve lead acquisition, enhance fraud detection, and support customer lifecycle management.

Candidates should bring strong problem-solving skills, a collaborative spirit, and flexibility to adapt to evolving priorities. Familiarity with industry-standard LMS platforms such as Infinity or Tekambi is required. Experience with automated ML platforms like DataRobot is strongly preferred. Direct experience in tribal lending or the broader consumer lending industry is a plus. This position will report to the Chief Risk Officer.

Essential Roles/Responsibilities

Insight & Data Science

· Develop, test, and deploy predictive models to support loan application decisioning, fraud detection, repayment risk, affordability assessments, and lead conversion.

· Support champion/challenger testing of consumer lending scorecards, underwriting rules, and lending policies.

· Conduct deep-dive analyses into loan performance, repayment behavior, and borrower characteristics; translate findings into actionable recommendations.

· Apply a variety of modeling techniques including regression, decision trees, gradient boosting, clustering, and neural networks.

· Leverage DataRobot and custom-built pipelines (Python/R) for model development, validation, and deployment.

· Collaborate with LMS platform Collaborate with LMS platform account executives (Infinity, Tekambi, or similar) to operationalize scorecards and decisioning logic.

· Perform back-testing, statistical validation, and ongoing monitoring to ensure models remain accurate and stable in production.

· Deliver clear visualizations and insights to stakeholders across risk, operations, and finance.

Data Management & Engineering Support

· Partner with BI/Technology teams to define, source, and maintain datasets used for lending analytics and portfolio monitoring.

· Use SQL (SSMS preferred) to query, clean, and transform large-scale lending data.

· Ensure data integrity, perform feature engineering, and document business rules used for modeling.

· Support development of automated pipelines to track model performance and portfolio KPIs.

Collaboration & Business Impact

· Work closely with Risk, Marketing, Operations, and Finance to align models with consumer lending strategies and portfolio goals.

· Support initiatives such as lead source optimization, pricing strategies, repayment forecasting, and fraud mitigation.

· Act as a subject matter expert on lending-focused modeling methodologies and statistical best practices.

· Stay current on AI/ML tools, bureau and third-party data offerings, and trends in the consumer lending industry.

Onboarding & Alignment (0–30 Days)

Gain a deep understanding of Makes Cents Inc.’s consumer lending business model, portfolio, and underwriting process.
Build working relationships with Risk, Operations, Marketing, and Technology stakeholders.
Access, validate, and familiarize with LMS platforms (Infinity, Tekambi) and key data pipelines.
Review existing consumer lending models, scorecards, and loan performance reports.

Early Deliverables (30-60 days):

Conduct an initial diagnostic of current loan decisioning models and risk scorecards; identify gaps and opportunities.
Begin developing at least one new or improved consumer lending model (e.g., fraud detection or repayment prediction) using DataRobot or Python/R.
Provide early insights into borrower risk patterns, repayment behavior, or lead source quality.
Document data sources, feature sets, and assumptions for a core initiative.

Impact & Execution (60–90 Days)

Deploy a new or updated model into champion/challenger testing within Infinity or Tekambi.
Deliver a 90-day report to leadership with findings, early results, and ROI estimates.
Propose a roadmap for future lending model development, monitoring, and automation.
Establish credibility as a trusted, collaborative data science partner across the business

Education Requirements

Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Econometrics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
PhD preferred but not required.

Qualifications

3–5+ years of experience in predictive modeling, applied data science, or analytics within consumer lending or fintech.
Strong experience with loan decisioning models, fraud detection, lead optimization, and repayment forecasting.
Hands-on experience with Infinity, Tekambi, or similar LMS/decisioning platforms.
Proven use of DataRobot or other AutoML platforms in production.
Experience in high-volume, data-intensive consumer lending environments.
Experience in tribal lending is highly preferred

Advanced SQL (SSMS preferred) for querying and data wrangling.
Familiarity with model interpretability tools (SHAP, LIME, etc.).
Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, Domo).
Familiarity with cloud-based environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Strong communication skills: able to explain technical findings in plain language.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

174 Power Global, headquartered in Irvine, California, is an affiliate company of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 firm that is among the eight largest business enterprises in South Korea. 174 Power Global designs, builds and manages solar power plant solutions. The company brings a decade of global leadership in solar PV to North America, combining best-of-world technology, processes, and partnerships to deliver utility-grade solar PV solutions customized for local energy markets. 174 Power Global offers the full spectrum of PV solutions – from power plant development, design, construction, operations, and maintenance. With proven capabilities across the solar value chain, 174 Power Global minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in solar energy.

174 Power Global has recently embarked on entering the energy retail market in deregulated markets throughout North America. Chariot Energy is a retail energy provider based in Houston, Texas. We offer electricity to homes and businesses, and it is our goal to provide products and services our customers love and an unmatched experience that is missing in today's retail energy market.

174 Power Global has set out to have Chariot Energy become one of the leading energy retail providers (by RCE count) within 5 years of Chariot Energy's launch.




POSITION OVERVIEW

As an integral part of Chariot Energy's Energy Analytics team, the Senior Data Scientist will oversee the entire data science pipeline for all wholesale applications including load forecasting, price formation and trading algorithms. This will encompass R&D, model development, pre and post model analytics, model deployment, and management of ML model library. This role will leverage the latest AI/ML modeling techniques to directly impact the company's ability to make informed decisions, optimize operations, mitigate risks, and drive business growth.

Reporting to the Head of Energy Analytics, the role requires a self-motivated, dedicated, and responsible individual with the ability to perform well under pressure collaboratively with a team of highly analytical and quantitative talent. Along with deep expertise in AI/ML modelling, the candidate should possess a solid understanding of ERCOT and PJM market fundamentals and emerging trends.

The employee may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. All duties will be assigned in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

The position will be based out of the Chariot Energy Houston office, and the ideal candidate will be within commutable distance to the Houston office location.




RESPONSIBILITIES

As part of Chariot Energy's Energy Analytics team, this position will play a pivotal role in developing innovative solutions to our wholesale analytical needs including load and price forecasting by applying state-of-the-art machine learning and predictive modeling techniques
Responsible for coordinating the entire ML life cycle including pre-model analytics, model selection, feature engineering, post model evaluation and model refinements
Coordinate the model deployment efforts including integration into downstream business processes and tracking performance metrics
Develop a comprehensive data visualization layer to enable intuitive understanding of the analytical drivers by the business stakeholders
Working closely with the technology team and leveraging the availability of vast amounts of proprietary data, develop ways to extract business intelligence and actionable insights that can have a meaningful impact on the company's bottom-line
Communicate technical details of the modeling to key stakeholders and partners to drive impact and facilitate decision making

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Strong technical knowledge on time series modelling (GBM, LSTM) and deep learning/generative AI (CNN, VAE, GAN)
10+ years of industry experience of applying the modelling techniques in successful business applications
Thorough understanding of the analytical drivers of the energy industry including weather, consumption patterns, wholesale and retail prices, particularly for ERCOT and PJM markets
An advanced degree, preferably Ph.D, in Engineering, Math, Physics or in a related field of study
Strong problem-solving skills along with ability to intuitively explain complex technical concepts to business stakeholders
Strong knowledge in programming (Python, SQL), visualization tools (Plotly, PowerBI), ML packages (Pytorch, Tensorflow) and hyperparameter tuning (Optuna)
Proven track record in managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams.
Excellent interpersonal skills with capability to work collaboratively with technical and non-technical teams.
Eligible to work in the USA for any employer without sponsorship.



Compensation: $160,000 - $185,000 salary




Chariot Energy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. www.mychariotenergy.com

As an AI/ML Research Engineer, you’ll play a crucial role in translating cutting-edge AI research into working prototypes and experimental implementations. Your primary focus will be on building and deploying machine learning models in secure research environments, transforming theoretical concepts into functional code that can be tested and validated. You’ll work closely with our research team to implement novel AI techniques and run comprehensive experiments that push the boundaries of what’s possible in AI technology.

This is an exceptional opportunity to be at the forefront of AI research implementation at a high-growth startup working with leading innovators in the AI field. This position is fully remote. However, applicants must be authorized to work for ANY employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

Experience with GPU provisioning, optimization, and modifying training code for various GPU configurations

Experience with Docker containerization and model deployment workflows

Job Summary:

We’re seeking an Enterprise Architect to lead AI adoption across software development teams. This role creates the shared context (standards, practices, and common services) that lets teams ship safe, reliable, and cost-effective AI features. You will define and govern our AI reference architecture, stand up platform capabilities (retrieval, orchestration, guardrails, observability), and guide the rollout of agentic AI for real business outcomes.

Responsibilities:
Set the North Star
Own the enterprise AI reference architecture (applications, data, security, and operations).
Define canonical domain models and patterns for shared context: knowledge sources, metadata, embeddings, ontologies, and retrieval.
Establish decision frameworks for build/buy, model selection, and cost/performance trade-offs.
Create Shared Context & Platform Services
Stand up common services: identity-aware retrieval (RAG), vector/graph storage, prompt/skill catalogs, tool/function registries, evaluation harnesses, and LLM observability.
Provide SDKs, templates, and reference implementations so teams can adopt patterns quickly (APIs, eventing, CI/CD, IaC).
Standards & Practices
Publish and govern AI engineering standards: prompt patterns, tool/agent orchestration, structured outputs, evaluation/testing, telemetry, and rollout gates.
Define SLOs/SQOs for AI features (quality, latency, cost, safety) and embed automated checks into pipelines.
Agentic AI Delivery
Architect agent workflows (plan–act–observe–reflect loops), tool usage, and multi-agent collaboration for real-world processes.
Pilot high-impact use cases; turn successful patterns into reusable components.
Risk, Security, and Compliance
Implement guardrails for privacy, safety, IP, and data residency; integrate content filtering, PII handling, and audit trails.
Partner with Legal, Risk, and Security on policy, red-teaming, incident response, and vendor due diligence.
Enablement & Change Management
Lead developer enablement: playbooks, training, office hours, internal community of practice.
Design and deliver a developer education program on implementing agentic coding (plan–act–observe–reflect loops, tool/skill catalogs, safety guardrails, evaluation and regression testing, cost control, and SDLC integration).
Drive citizen intelligence/development governance with safe rails and supported toolchains.
Advise product leaders on AI opportunity sizing, success metrics, and ethical considerations.
Education & Training (Agentic Coding)
Lead developer enablement: playbooks, training, office hours, internal community of practice.
Design and deliver a developer education program on implementing agentic coding (plan–act–observe–reflect loops, tool/skill catalogs, safety guardrails, evaluation and regression testing, cost control, and SDLC integration).
Drive citizen intelligence/development governance with safe rails and supported toolchains.
Advise product leaders on AI opportunity sizing, success metrics, and ethical considerations.
Qualifications:
5+ years in software/enterprise architecture; 3+ years building LLM/AI solutions at scale.
Deep knowledge of LLM patterns: RAG, fine-tuning/adapter strategies, function/tool calling, structured output, evaluation, caching.
Strong platform background: API design, microservices, IAM/zero-trust, observability, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform), and cost management.
Data foundations: domain modeling, data lifecycle governance, vector/graph stores, catalog/lineage, feature stores.
